Update Depths in a WEMo input

Source: R/update_depths.R
update_depths.Rd

Update the depth values in a object created by prepare_wemo_inputs().

Usage

update_depths(wemo_input, depth_diff)

Arguments

wemo_input

sf object with column depths which is a list of vectors

depth_diff

numeric. indicates the amount to increase (or decrease for negative values)

Value

sf object ready for processing in wemo()
